method: Each library is sorted independently for each metric; percentile=100*rank/(n-1), with rank starting at zero. No interpolation, absolute-value conversion, or missing-value imputation.
limitations: The common Yosys/ABC Nangate45 and pre-layout OpenSTA/OpenROAD flow, including identical timing/loading/activity assumptions, is maintainer-reported. Scripts, tool versions, exact corner, voltage, temperature, and numerical constraints/activity were not supplied.
Negative adder timing values are plotted verbatim and identified as unresolved reported timing, rather than physical propagation delay.
EvoApprox model code and timing/power reports were not supplied here; its CSV verification flags are source-reported and have not been independently rerun.
Power curves use reported total_uw, without reconstructing totals from rounded components.
Original-paper synthesis results are separate characterization contexts; no paper measurements were substituted into these CSV plots.
